**Update** After one year it died. Previous model still going strong. Not worth dealing with trying to have it repaired. Please see other reviews expressing exact same concerns as me.

I am a repeat customer. I also own the Danby DDW611WLED Countertop Dishwasher. I could not be happier with that dishwasher. However, this dishwasher is terrible. I own both at the same time. Because the new rack is so poorly arranged, I can not fit even half the number of dishes in this new one that I can in the old one. They also removed the timer. Now I have no idea how much time is left in the cycle.

Some people have said, "Buy a whole new dish set that fits." Should not have to do that when previous model held my dishes just fine.
Some people have said, "But the manufacturer says this one holds more." Maybe with whatever set of dishes they were using to get the maximum numbers they could for marketing, but in the real world, things are different. Wouldn't it be great if everything manufacturers claimed was true.

I love my old dishwasher. It does everything I want. However I could not be more disappointed in this newer model. Please stay away from this one. Buy the older model while you still can.

Best dishwasher I have ever owned.  I have sent 5, high quality, full size, dishwashers to the charity shop in 5 years because the dishes came OUT worse than they were when I put them IN, after being pre washed with soap and hot water, they were actually cloudy when they came out.  Yuk! So in a state of advanced fed up ness, having listened to all of the lame justifications from sales persons that I can tolerate, I thought, as a last ditch effort, for the sake of my manicure, maybe just to do the silverware, I'd give this a shot.  WHAT A SHOCK!  It produces the cleanest dishes I have ever seen.  Hint: use those Finish Quantum detergent pillow things.  OK, so it isn't engineered to handle really large plates, just put them in on a bit of a slant. I did not pre wash, pre rinse or anything else except to shake off the big chunks. This is the acid test, right?  It dealt with cheese enchiladas with dried on sour cream like a champ.  Mirror bright dishes.  REALLY clean silverware!  Zowie!  Note, this is probably not your product if you are a family of four or more, but for one or two people, or for an apartment, this one absolutely gets the blue ribbon!!!  I've now done about 10 loads and I'm still amazed every time I empty it.  It fit my pedestal cake plate, casserole dishes, all the usual things.  Not mad about snapping the water hose onto the faucet to use it, but I'll get over that, the dishes are sparkling clean!  I am absolutely amazed.
